text:
Anita: FYI opened a docs PR with Dedicated autoscale CLI examples and a short migration note. Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4678. Need quick review for wording, metric names, and one link fix (SLA doc). cc @eng-runtime
Sam: grabbing it now. quick q — the example uses `queue_length` as the scale metric, we usually recommend `avg_inflight` for inference queues. Can we show both?
Kevin: saw the PR, also add a footnote about eviction/isolation impact on latency SLAs. Where should we link for the SLA table?
Anita: good call on both metrics — I added a second CLI example to show `--metric avg_inflight` and a YAML snippet for k8s-based infra. For SLA link, point to /docs/sla/dedicated-capacity (I think the canonical is internal doc -> will patch link).
Sam: snippet suggestion — put the CLI first, then the YAML. Example:
```
# set a policy that scales at 70% avg_inflight over 30s
redwoodctl dedicated scale set-policy --pool my-reserved --name bursty-api --metric avg_inflight --threshold 0.7 --window 30s --min 1 --max 8
```
Kevin: wording tweak: we use `scale_policy` in API examples (snake_case) but CLI shows `set-policy`. Might confuse folks. Maybe add a short note: "CLI flags differ from API field names".
Maria: I can run the docs preview and check the link targets and TOC placement. Will also validate the fenced code blocks render correctly.
docs-bot: Preview build queued for PR 4678 — https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/4678 — status: pending
Sam: minor nit: the YAML autoscale example references `quant_profile: q4_0` — we should call out that quantization can affect memory and eviction behavior; maybe link to Optimize/quantization guide.
Anita: added a short sentence and link to /docs/optimize/quantization-guide. Also fixed a broken anchor in the SLA doc (internal -> public path change).
docs-bot: Preview build updated for PR 4678 — https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/4678 — status: success
Kevin: looks good from my side. The isolation paragraph could use one more sentence: "Reserved pools with strict isolation may not be eligible for cross-pool bursting; check your reservation policy." I added that in a follow-up commit.
Maria: preview rendered clean. TOC placement is fine, links resolve. One small link to the console screenshot was broken -> I patched it in the PR (assets/ -> assets/images/).
Sam: LGTM aside from the tiny casing note, which I left inline.
Anita: thanks all. I will merge after CI is green and Maria confirms preview. Will also add a brief migration note to the Dedicated quickstart about `scale_policy` rename.
Maria: CI green, preview confirmed. Merge when ready. :shipit:
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Anita: merging now, will follow up with a quick slack announcement in #product. Thanks for the quick turn-around!
